text_block_list.text:
One evening, I saw an exhausted Grass 
Wonder returning from an outing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my head is spinning... That way is 
the sky, that way is the ground, and 
that's... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Do you know this feeling, Trainer...? The 
joy of being able to plant my feet on the 
ground—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you familiar with the bright red 
supercar often parked in the academy lot?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If Maruzen-san invites you for a drive and 
you casually get into that car—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You might get to experience the moment a 
car takes flight too, Trainer... Fufufu...

As Grass Wonder smiled with distant eyes, 
I silently swore to always be wary of 
supercars.
